.o11-section {
  background-color: #050505;
  padding: 80px 0;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  color: #ffffff;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.o11-container {
  max-width: 1300px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 30px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px;
  gap: 60px;
  align-items: start;
}

/* TYPOGRAFIA CONTENTU */
.o11-title {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 54px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -1.5px;
  margin: 0 0 30px 0;
}

.o11-lime { color: #a3ff33; }

.o11-intro {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #cccccc;
  margin-bottom: 50px;
  max-width: 800px;
}

.o11-intro strong { color: #ffffff; }

.o11-subtitle {
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 40px 0;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

/* LISTA CECH - NAPRAWA UKŁADU (Numer obok tekstu) */
.o11-features {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.o11-feature {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; /* Sztywne ułożenie numeru obok tekstu */
  gap: 30px;
  padding: 40px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.o11-feature-num {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #a3ff33;
  font-family: monospace;
  padding-top: 6px;
}

.o11-feature-text h3 {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 12px 0;
  color: #ffffff;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.o11-feature-text p {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #999999;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* EFEKT NAJAZDU (HOVER) */
.o11-feature:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.05) 0%, transparent 100%);
  padding-left: 25px;
}

.o11-feature:hover .o11-feature-text h3 {
  color: #a3ff33;
}

/* SIDEBAR - STICKY I LINKI */
.o11-sidebar {
  position: -webkit-sticky;
  position: sticky;
  top: 100px;
}

.o11-widget {
  background: #111111;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 30px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.o11-widget-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: #666666;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.o11-nav-menu {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.o11-nav-link {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: #999999;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
}

.o11-nav-link svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  opacity: 0.3;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.o11-nav-link:hover, .o11-nav-link.active {
  color: #a3ff33;
}

.o11-nav-link:hover svg, .o11-nav-link.active svg {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate(3px, -3px);
}

/* PRZYCISK TELEFONU - FIX */
.o11-btn-fix {
  display: flex !important;
  background-color: #a3ff33 !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  padding: 18px 25px !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  margin-top: 10px !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
}

.o11-btn-fix:hover {
  background-color: #ffffff !important;
  transform: translateY(-3px) !important;
}

.o11-btn-fix svg {
  margin-right: 12px;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  stroke: #000000 !important;
}

/* RESPONSYWNOŚĆ */
@media (max-width: 992px) {
  .o11-container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .o11-sidebar { position: static; }
  .o11-feature { padding: 30px 0; }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .o11-feature {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr; /* Na telefonach numer nad tekstem */
    gap: 10px;
  }
}/* End custom CSS */
.elementor-theme-builder-content-area{height:400px;}.elementor-location-header:before, .elementor-location-footer:before{content:"";display:table;clear:both;}/* Start custom CSS for html, class: .elementor-element-4fee9f0 *//* --- SEKCJA O1 - NAGŁÓWEK GŁÓWNY (JEDNOLITY KOLOR) --- */

/* 1. Baza i Reset pozycjonowania */
html, body {
  overflow-x: clip !important;
}

body {
  padding-top: 75px !important; /* Rezerwacja miejsca pod fixed header */
}

/* 2. Główny kontener paska */
.o1-header {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  z-index: 9999;
  /* KLUCZOWA ZMIANA: Jednolity kolor bez przezroczystości i blur */
  background-color: #0a0a0a; 
  border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a1a;
  padding: 12px 0;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
}

.o1-container {
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 40px;
}

/* 3. Logo */
.o1-logo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  text-decoration: none;
  line-height: 0.9;
}

.o1-logo-top {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.o1-logo-bottom {
  color: #a3ff33;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

/* 4. Nawigacja Desktop */
.o1-nav {
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.o1-nav-list {
  display: flex;
  list-style: none;
  gap: 25px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.o1-nav-link {
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.8;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
  padding: 10px 5px;
}

.o1-nav-link:hover, 
.o1-nav-link.active {
  opacity: 1;
  color: #a3ff33;
}

/* 5. Kontener Kontaktowy (Prawy) */
.o1-contact {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  background-color: #161616; /* Jednolity ciemny szary dla odróżnienia */
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #222222;
}

.o1-contact-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.o1-contact-phone {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.o1-contact-email {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #a3ff33;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.o1-contact-phone:hover,
.o1-contact-email:hover {
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* 6. Burger Menu (Domyślnie ukryty) */
.o1-burger {
  display: none;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 10px;
  z-index: 10001;
}

.o1-burger span {
  display: block;
  width: 25px;
  height: 2px;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  margin: 5px 0;
  transition: 0.3s;
}

/* 7. RESPONSYWNOŚĆ */

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .o1-container {
    padding: 0 20px;
  }

  /* Menu mobilne jako pełny ekran */
  .o1-nav {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    right: -100%;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    background-color: #0a0a0a; /* Jednolity kolor na mobile */
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    z-index: 10000;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .o1-nav.o1-active {
    right: 0;
  }

  .o1-nav-list {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 30px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .o1-nav-link {
    font-size: 22px;
    padding: 15px;
  }

  .o1-burger {
    display: block;
    margin-left: 10px;
  }

  /* Animacja burgera do znaku X */
  .o1-burger.o1-open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
  .o1-burger.o1-open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
  .o1-burger.o1-open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .o1-contact-email {
    display: none; /* Ukrywamy e-mail na bardzo małych ekranach dla czytelności */
  }
  
  .o1-logo-top {
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .o1-contact {
    padding: 10px;
  }
}/* End custom CSS */

}

  font-size: 13px;
  text-decoration: none;

  opacity: 0.9;
}
.o9-phone:hover, .o9-email:hover { color: #a3ff33; opacity: 1; }

.o9-divider { height: 1px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); margin-bottom: 20px; }

.o9-company-info p { color: #ffffff; font-size: 12px; margin: 0 0 5px 0; opacity: 0.9; }

/* --- SEKCJA O11 - REWITALIZACJA DESIGNU --- */

.o11-lime { color: #a3ff33; }

}

.o11-subtitle {

  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 40px 0;

}

.o11-features {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.o11-feature-text h3 {

}

.o11-feature-text p {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #999999;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* EFEKT NAJAZDU (HOVER) */

  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.05) 0%, transparent 100%);

}

.o11-feature:hover .o11-feature-text h3 {

}

.o11-nav-menu {

}

.o11-nav-link {

.o11-nav-link svg {

  margin-top: 10px !important;

.o11-btn-fix:hover {

========================================= */

.mwww-product-desc {
  --mwww-green: #a3ff33;
  --mwww-green-2: #b7ff00;
  --mwww-bg: #050505;
  --mwww-card: #0d0f0d;
  --mwww-card-2: #111411;
  --mwww-border: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --mwww-border-green: rgba(163,255,51,.28);
  --mwww-text: #f5f5f5;
  --mwww-muted: #a9aea9;

  width: 100%;
  color: var(--mwww-text);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.mwww-product-desc *,
.mwww-product-desc *::before,
.mwww-product-desc *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mwww-product-desc p {
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  color: var(--mwww-muted);
}

.mwww-product-desc strong {
  color: #fff;
}


/* INTRO */

.mwww-product-desc__intro {
  padding: 38px;
  margin-bottom: 26px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border);
  border-radius: 18px;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 10%,
      rgba(163,255,51,.09),
      transparent 30%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #0c0e0c,
      #070807
    );
}

.mwww-product-desc__eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;

  margin-bottom: 14px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .15em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__intro h2 {
  max-width: 950px;

  margin: 0 0 20px !important;

  color: #fff !important;
  font-size: clamp(30px, 3vw, 48px) !important;
  line-height: 1.1 !important;
  letter-spacing: -.025em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__intro h2 span {
  color: var(--mwww-green);
}

.mwww-product-desc__lead {
  max-width: 1100px;

  color: #d2d6d2 !important;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}


/* SEKCJE */

.mwww-product-desc__section {
  padding: 34px 0;

  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mwww-border);
}

.mwww-product-desc__heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 16px;

  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__heading > span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;

  flex: 0 0 44px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border-green);
  border-radius: 12px;

  background: rgba(163,255,51,.06);

  color: var(--mwww-green);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.mwww-product-desc__heading small {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 5px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .13em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__heading h3 {
  margin: 0 !important;

  color: #fff !important;
  font-size: clamp(23px, 2.2vw, 32px) !important;
  line-height: 1.15 !important;
}


/* FEATURES */

.mwww-product-desc__features {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__feature {
  min-height: 150px;

  padding: 20px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border);
  border-radius: 14px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      rgba(18,20,18,.95),
      rgba(8,9,8,.95)
    );

  transition:
    border-color .25s ease,
    transform .25s ease;
}

.mwww-product-desc__feature:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: var(--mwww-border-green);
}

.mwww-product-desc__feature::before {
  content: "";

  display: block;

  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;

  margin-bottom: 15px;

  border-radius: 50%;

  background: var(--mwww-green);

  box-shadow:
    0 0 16px rgba(163,255,51,.45);
}

.mwww-product-desc__feature strong {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 7px;

  font-size: 15px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__feature p {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}


/* SEO */

.mwww-product-desc__seo-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px;
  gap: 26px;
  align-items: center;
}

.mwww-product-desc__seo-box {
  padding: 24px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border-green);
  border-radius: 16px;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 80% 10%,
      rgba(163,255,51,.12),
      transparent 40%
    ),
    #0c0f0c;
}

.mwww-product-desc__seo-box > span {
  display: inline-block;

  margin-bottom: 12px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: .15em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__seo-box strong {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 10px;

  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.mwww-product-desc__seo-box p {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 13px;
}


/* KROKI */

.mwww-product-desc__steps {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__step {
  padding: 20px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border);
  border-radius: 14px;

  background: var(--mwww-card);
}

.mwww-product-desc__step > span {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 14px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);
  font-size: 26px;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.mwww-product-desc__step strong {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 8px;

  font-size: 15px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__step p {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 13px;
}


/* CZAS / CENA */

.mwww-product-desc__time {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;

  margin: 32px 0;
}

.mwww-product-desc__time > div {
  padding: 28px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border-green);
  border-radius: 16px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #0e110e,
      #090a09
    );
}

.mwww-product-desc__time small {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 6px;

  color: var(--mwww-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__time strong {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 8px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);

  font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 42px);
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.mwww-product-desc__time p {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 13px;
}


/* BENEFITY */

.mwww-product-desc__benefits {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;

  margin-top: 22px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__benefits span {
  padding: 10px 15px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border);
  border-radius: 999px;

  background: #0c0e0c;

  color: #d8ddd8;

  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.mwww-product-desc__benefits span::before {
  content: "•";

  margin-right: 8px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);
}


/* CTA */

.mwww-product-desc__cta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 30px;

  margin-top: 32px;

  padding: 34px;

  overflow: hidden;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border-green);
  border-radius: 18px;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 50%,
      rgba(163,255,51,.15),
      transparent 36%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #0e110e,
      #070807
    );
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta > div:first-child {
  max-width: 760px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta > div:first-child > span {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 8px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);

  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: .14em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta h3 {
  margin: 0 0 12px !important;

  color: #fff !important;

  font-size: clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 36px) !important;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta p {
  margin: 0;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta-info {
  min-width: 230px;

  padding: 20px 24px;

  border: 1px solid rgba(163,255,51,.32);
  border-radius: 14px;

  background: rgba(0,0,0,.25);

  text-align: center;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta-info strong {
  display: block;

  color: var(--mwww-green);

  font-size: 27px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta-info small {
  color: #b9beb9;
}


/* RESPONSYWNOŚĆ */

@media (max-width: 1050px) {

  .mwww-product-desc__features,
  .mwww-product-desc__steps {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__seo-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__seo-box {
    max-width: none;
  }

}


@media (max-width: 700px) {

  .mwww-product-desc {
    font-size: 15px;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__intro {
    padding: 24px 20px;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__section {
    padding: 28px 0;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__features,
  .mwww-product-desc__steps,
  .mwww-product-desc__time {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__heading {
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__heading > span {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    flex-basis: 38px;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__cta {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;

    padding: 24px 20px;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__cta-info {
    min-width: 0;
  }

.o11-section {
  background-color: #050505;
  padding: 80px 0;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  color: #ffffff;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.o11-container {
  max-width: 1300px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 30px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px;
  gap: 60px;
  align-items: start;
}

/* TYPOGRAFIA CONTENTU */
.o11-title {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 54px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -1.5px;
  margin: 0 0 30px 0;
}

.o11-lime { color: #a3ff33; }

.o11-intro {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #cccccc;
  margin-bottom: 50px;
  max-width: 800px;
}

.o11-intro strong { color: #ffffff; }

.o11-subtitle {
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 40px 0;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

/* LISTA CECH - NAPRAWA UKŁADU (Numer obok tekstu) */
.o11-features {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.o11-feature {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; /* Sztywne ułożenie numeru obok tekstu */
  gap: 30px;
  padding: 40px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.o11-feature-num {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #a3ff33;
  font-family: monospace;
  padding-top: 6px;
}

.o11-feature-text h3 {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 12px 0;
  color: #ffffff;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.o11-feature-text p {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #999999;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* EFEKT NAJAZDU (HOVER) */
.o11-feature:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.05) 0%, transparent 100%);
  padding-left: 25px;
}

.o11-feature:hover .o11-feature-text h3 {
  color: #a3ff33;
}

/* SIDEBAR - STICKY I LINKI */
.o11-sidebar {
  position: -webkit-sticky;
  position: sticky;
  top: 100px;
}

.o11-widget {
  background: #111111;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 30px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.o11-widget-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: #666666;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.o11-nav-menu {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.o11-nav-link {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: #999999;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
}

.o11-nav-link svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  opacity: 0.3;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.o11-nav-link:hover, .o11-nav-link.active {
  color: #a3ff33;
}

.o11-nav-link:hover svg, .o11-nav-link.active svg {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate(3px, -3px);
}

/* PRZYCISK TELEFONU - FIX */
.o11-btn-fix {
  display: flex !important;
  background-color: #a3ff33 !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  padding: 18px 25px !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  margin-top: 10px !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
}

.o11-btn-fix:hover {
  background-color: #ffffff !important;
  transform: translateY(-3px) !important;
}

.o11-btn-fix svg {
  margin-right: 12px;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  stroke: #000000 !important;
}

/* RESPONSYWNOŚĆ */
@media (max-width: 992px) {
  .o11-container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .o11-sidebar { position: static; }
  .o11-feature { padding: 30px 0; }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .o11-feature {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr; /* Na telefonach numer nad tekstem */
    gap: 10px;
  }
}/* End custom CSS */
.elementor-theme-builder-content-area{height:400px;}.elementor-location-header:before, .elementor-location-footer:before{content:"";display:table;clear:both;}/* Start custom CSS for html, class: .elementor-element-4fee9f0 *//* --- SEKCJA O1 - NAGŁÓWEK GŁÓWNY (JEDNOLITY KOLOR) --- */

/* 1. Baza i Reset pozycjonowania */
html, body {
  overflow-x: clip !important;
}

body {
  padding-top: 75px !important; /* Rezerwacja miejsca pod fixed header */
}

/* 2. Główny kontener paska */
.o1-header {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  z-index: 9999;
  /* KLUCZOWA ZMIANA: Jednolity kolor bez przezroczystości i blur */
  background-color: #0a0a0a; 
  border-bottom: 1px solid #1a1a1a;
  padding: 12px 0;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
}

.o1-container {
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 40px;
}

/* 3. Logo */
.o1-logo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  text-decoration: none;
  line-height: 0.9;
}

.o1-logo-top {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.o1-logo-bottom {
  color: #a3ff33;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

/* 4. Nawigacja Desktop */
.o1-nav {
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.o1-nav-list {
  display: flex;
  list-style: none;
  gap: 25px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.o1-nav-link {
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.8;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
  padding: 10px 5px;
}

.o1-nav-link:hover, 
.o1-nav-link.active {
  opacity: 1;
  color: #a3ff33;
}

/* 5. Kontener Kontaktowy (Prawy) */
.o1-contact {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  background-color: #161616; /* Jednolity ciemny szary dla odróżnienia */
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid #222222;
}

.o1-contact-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.o1-contact-phone {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.o1-contact-email {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #a3ff33;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.o1-contact-phone:hover,
.o1-contact-email:hover {
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* 6. Burger Menu (Domyślnie ukryty) */
.o1-burger {
  display: none;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 10px;
  z-index: 10001;
}

.o1-burger span {
  display: block;
  width: 25px;
  height: 2px;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  margin: 5px 0;
  transition: 0.3s;
}

/* 7. RESPONSYWNOŚĆ */

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .o1-container {
    padding: 0 20px;
  }

  /* Menu mobilne jako pełny ekran */
  .o1-nav {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    right: -100%;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    background-color: #0a0a0a; /* Jednolity kolor na mobile */
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    z-index: 10000;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .o1-nav.o1-active {
    right: 0;
  }

  .o1-nav-list {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 30px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .o1-nav-link {
    font-size: 22px;
    padding: 15px;
  }

  .o1-burger {
    display: block;
    margin-left: 10px;
  }

  /* Animacja burgera do znaku X */
  .o1-burger.o1-open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
  .o1-burger.o1-open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
  .o1-burger.o1-open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .o1-contact-email {
    display: none; /* Ukrywamy e-mail na bardzo małych ekranach dla czytelności */
  }
  
  .o1-logo-top {
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .o1-contact {
    padding: 10px;
  }
}/* End custom CSS */

/* --- SEKCJA O11 - REWITALIZACJA DESIGNU --- */

.o11-section {
  background-color: #050505;
  padding: 80px 0;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  color: #ffffff;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.o11-container {
  max-width: 1300px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 30px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px;
  gap: 60px;
  align-items: start;
}

/* TYPOGRAFIA CONTENTU */
.o11-title {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 54px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -1.5px;
  margin: 0 0 30px 0;
}

.o11-lime { color: #a3ff33; }

.o11-intro {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #cccccc;
  margin-bottom: 50px;
  max-width: 800px;
}

.o11-intro strong { color: #ffffff; }

.o11-subtitle {
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 40px 0;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

/* LISTA CECH - NAPRAWA UKŁADU (Numer obok tekstu) */
.o11-features {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.o11-feature {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr; /* Sztywne ułożenie numeru obok tekstu */
  gap: 30px;
  padding: 40px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.o11-feature-num {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #a3ff33;
  font-family: monospace;
  padding-top: 6px;
}

.o11-feature-text h3 {
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 12px 0;
  color: #ffffff;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.o11-feature-text p {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #999999;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

/* EFEKT NAJAZDU (HOVER) */
.o11-feature:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.05) 0%, transparent 100%);
  padding-left: 25px;
}

.o11-feature:hover .o11-feature-text h3 {
  color: #a3ff33;
}

/* SIDEBAR - STICKY I LINKI */
.o11-sidebar {
  position: -webkit-sticky;
  position: sticky;
  top: 100px;
}

.o11-widget {
  background: #111111;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 30px;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.o11-widget-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: #666666;
  margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.o11-nav-menu {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.o11-nav-link {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 15px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: #999999;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: 0.3s ease;
}

.o11-nav-link svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  opacity: 0.3;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.o11-nav-link:hover, .o11-nav-link.active {
  color: #a3ff33;
}

.o11-nav-link:hover svg, .o11-nav-link.active svg {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translate(3px, -3px);
}

/* PRZYCISK TELEFONU - FIX */
.o11-btn-fix {
  display: flex !important;
  background-color: #a3ff33 !important;
  color: #000000 !important;
  padding: 18px 25px !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  margin-top: 10px !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
}

.o11-btn-fix:hover {
  background-color: #ffffff !important;
  transform: translateY(-3px) !important;
}

.o11-btn-fix svg {
  margin-right: 12px;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  stroke: #000000 !important;
}

/* RESPONSYWNOŚĆ */
@media (max-width: 992px) {
  .o11-container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .o11-sidebar { position: static; }
  .o11-feature { padding: 30px 0; }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .o11-feature {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr; /* Na telefonach numer nad tekstem */
    gap: 10px;
  }
}

/* --- SPIS TREŚCI (TOC) --- */
.o-toc-box {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-left: 3px solid #a3ff33;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 25px;
  margin: 35px 0;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
}
.o-toc-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #ffffff;
  margin: 0 0 15px 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.o-toc-list {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.o-toc-list li a {
  color: #bbbbbb;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 15px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.o-toc-list li a::before {
  content: "→";
  color: #a3ff33;
  font-weight: bold;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}
.o-toc-list li a:hover {
  color: #ffffff;
}
.o-toc-list li a:hover::before {
  transform: translateX(4px);
}

/* --- SEKCJA PROCES TWORZENIA STRONY (o19) --- */
.o19-section {
  background-color: #0a0a0a;
  padding: 80px 20px;
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
  color: #ffffff;
}
.o19-container {
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.o19-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 60px;
}
.o19-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  background: rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.2);
  padding: 6px 16px;
  border-radius: 50px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.o19-badge-dot {
  width: 6px; height: 6px;
  background: #a3ff33;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.6);
}
.o19-title {
  font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 42px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin: 0 0 15px 0;
  letter-spacing: -1px;
}
.o19-lime { color: #a3ff33; }
.o19-desc {
  color: #cccccc;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin: 0 auto;
  max-width: 700px;
}

/* KROKI PROCESU (GRID) */
.o19-steps {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 30px;
  position: relative;
}
/* Linia łącząca kroki (tylko na desktop) */
.o19-line {
  position: absolute;
  top: 40px;
  left: 15%;
  right: 15%;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.3), transparent);
  z-index: 0;
}
.o19-step {
  background: #050505;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 40px 30px;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.o19-step:hover {
  border-color: rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.4);
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}
.o19-step-num {
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  background: #111111;
  border: 2px solid #a3ff33;
  color: #a3ff33;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 900;
  margin: 0 auto 25px auto;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.1);
}
.o19-step-title {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}
.o19-step-desc {
  color: #999999;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  margin: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 992px) {
  .o19-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .o19-line { display: none; }
}

/* ZAAWANSOWANY STYL FAQ 30 - 2 KOLUMNY */

    background-color: #050505;
    padding: 80px 20px;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    color: #ffffff;
}
.faq-container {
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}
.faq-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 60px;

.faq-badge {
    background: rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.1);

    border-radius: 50px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-transform: uppercase;

.faq-subtitle { color: #888; font-size: 16px; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; }

/* ETYKIETY GRUP PYTAŃ */

.faq-item:hover {
    border-color: rgba(163, 255, 51, 0.4);
    background: #111;
}

.faq-item summary {
    padding: 20px 25px;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    color: #eee;
}

.faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }

.faq-item summary::after {
    content: '+';
    color: #a3ff33;
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 300;
    transition: 0.3s;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-left: 15px;
}

.faq-item[open] summary {
    color: #a3ff33;
}

.faq-item[open] summary::after {
    transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.faq-answer {
    padding: 0 25px 25px;
    color: #aaa;
    line-height: 1.7;
    font-size: 13px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    padding-top: 15px;
}

/* RESPONSYWNOŚĆ */
@media (max-width: 992px) {
    .faq-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 12px;
    }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .faq-item summary { font-size: 14px; padding: 15px 20px; }
    .faq-title { font-size: 32px; }
}

/* =========================================
   MASZWWW.PL - OPIS PRODUKTU
   INDYWIDUALNA STRONA INTERNETOWA
========================================= */

.mwww-product-desc {
  --mwww-green: #a3ff33;
  --mwww-green-2: #b7ff00;
  --mwww-bg: #050505;
  --mwww-card: #0d0f0d;
  --mwww-card-2: #111411;
  --mwww-border: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --mwww-border-green: rgba(163,255,51,.28);
  --mwww-text: #f5f5f5;
  --mwww-muted: #a9aea9;

  width: 100%;
  color: var(--mwww-text);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.mwww-product-desc *,
.mwww-product-desc *::before,
.mwww-product-desc *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.mwww-product-desc p {
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  color: var(--mwww-muted);
}

.mwww-product-desc strong {
  color: #fff;
}


/* INTRO */

.mwww-product-desc__intro {
  padding: 38px;
  margin-bottom: 26px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border);
  border-radius: 18px;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 10%,
      rgba(163,255,51,.09),
      transparent 30%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #0c0e0c,
      #070807
    );
}

.mwww-product-desc__eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;

  margin-bottom: 14px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .15em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__intro h2 {
  max-width: 950px;

  margin: 0 0 20px !important;

  color: #fff !important;
  font-size: clamp(30px, 3vw, 48px) !important;
  line-height: 1.1 !important;
  letter-spacing: -.025em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__intro h2 span {
  color: var(--mwww-green);
}

.mwww-product-desc__lead {
  max-width: 1100px;

  color: #d2d6d2 !important;
  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.75;
}


/* SEKCJE */

.mwww-product-desc__section {
  padding: 34px 0;

  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mwww-border);
}

.mwww-product-desc__heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 16px;

  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__heading > span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;

  flex: 0 0 44px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border-green);
  border-radius: 12px;

  background: rgba(163,255,51,.06);

  color: var(--mwww-green);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.mwww-product-desc__heading small {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 5px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: .13em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__heading h3 {
  margin: 0 !important;

  color: #fff !important;
  font-size: clamp(23px, 2.2vw, 32px) !important;
  line-height: 1.15 !important;
}


/* FEATURES */

.mwww-product-desc__features {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__feature {
  min-height: 150px;

  padding: 20px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border);
  border-radius: 14px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      rgba(18,20,18,.95),
      rgba(8,9,8,.95)
    );

  transition:
    border-color .25s ease,
    transform .25s ease;
}

.mwww-product-desc__feature:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: var(--mwww-border-green);
}

.mwww-product-desc__feature::before {
  content: "";

  display: block;

  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;

  margin-bottom: 15px;

  border-radius: 50%;

  background: var(--mwww-green);

  box-shadow:
    0 0 16px rgba(163,255,51,.45);
}

.mwww-product-desc__feature strong {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 7px;

  font-size: 15px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__feature p {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}


/* SEO */

.mwww-product-desc__seo-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px;
  gap: 26px;
  align-items: center;
}

.mwww-product-desc__seo-box {
  padding: 24px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border-green);
  border-radius: 16px;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 80% 10%,
      rgba(163,255,51,.12),
      transparent 40%
    ),
    #0c0f0c;
}

.mwww-product-desc__seo-box > span {
  display: inline-block;

  margin-bottom: 12px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: .15em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__seo-box strong {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 10px;

  font-size: 18px;
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.mwww-product-desc__seo-box p {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 13px;
}


/* KROKI */

.mwww-product-desc__steps {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 14px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__step {
  padding: 20px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border);
  border-radius: 14px;

  background: var(--mwww-card);
}

.mwww-product-desc__step > span {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 14px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);
  font-size: 26px;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.mwww-product-desc__step strong {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 8px;

  font-size: 15px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__step p {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 13px;
}


/* CZAS / CENA */

.mwww-product-desc__time {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;

  margin: 32px 0;
}

.mwww-product-desc__time > div {
  padding: 28px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border-green);
  border-radius: 16px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      #0e110e,
      #090a09
    );
}

.mwww-product-desc__time small {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 6px;

  color: var(--mwww-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__time strong {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 8px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);

  font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 42px);
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.mwww-product-desc__time p {
  margin: 0;

  font-size: 13px;
}


/* BENEFITY */

.mwww-product-desc__benefits {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;

  margin-top: 22px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__benefits span {
  padding: 10px 15px;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border);
  border-radius: 999px;

  background: #0c0e0c;

  color: #d8ddd8;

  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.mwww-product-desc__benefits span::before {
  content: "•";

  margin-right: 8px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);
}


/* CTA */

.mwww-product-desc__cta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 30px;

  margin-top: 32px;

  padding: 34px;

  overflow: hidden;

  border: 1px solid var(--mwww-border-green);
  border-radius: 18px;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 50%,
      rgba(163,255,51,.15),
      transparent 36%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      #0e110e,
      #070807
    );
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta > div:first-child {
  max-width: 760px;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta > div:first-child > span {
  display: block;

  margin-bottom: 8px;

  color: var(--mwww-green);

  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: .14em;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta h3 {
  margin: 0 0 12px !important;

  color: #fff !important;

  font-size: clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 36px) !important;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta p {
  margin: 0;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta-info {
  min-width: 230px;

  padding: 20px 24px;

  border: 1px solid rgba(163,255,51,.32);
  border-radius: 14px;

  background: rgba(0,0,0,.25);

  text-align: center;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta-info strong {
  display: block;

  color: var(--mwww-green);

  font-size: 27px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.mwww-product-desc__cta-info small {
  color: #b9beb9;
}


/* RESPONSYWNOŚĆ */

@media (max-width: 1050px) {

  .mwww-product-desc__features,
  .mwww-product-desc__steps {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__seo-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__seo-box {
    max-width: none;
  }

}


@media (max-width: 700px) {

  .mwww-product-desc {
    font-size: 15px;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__intro {
    padding: 24px 20px;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__section {
    padding: 28px 0;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__features,
  .mwww-product-desc__steps,
  .mwww-product-desc__time {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__heading {
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__heading > span {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    flex-basis: 38px;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__cta {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;

    padding: 24px 20px;
  }

  .mwww-product-desc__cta-info {
    min-width: 0;
  }

Leszno to prężny ośrodek gospodarczy o strategicznym położeniu. Znajdując się w połowie drogi między Poznaniem a Wrocławiem przy trasie S5, miasto stanowi doskonałą bazę do prowadzenia i rozwijania działalności o zasięgu regionalnym i ogólnopolskim.
Lokalne firmy z branży produkcyjnej, handlowej i rolniczej muszą dziś jednak mocno konkurować o uwagę odbiorcy. Aby skutecznie budować zaufanie i docierać do nowych kontrahentów, niezbędna jest profesjonalna, widoczna wizytówka w sieci.
Jeśli interesuje Cię nowoczesna strona internetowa, nasza agencja dostarczy Ci rozwiązanie, które zaprezentuje Twoją markę z najlepszej strony i zamieni internetowy ruch w realne zyski finansowe.
Nasze projekty opieramy na stabilnym, bezpiecznym i niezwykle elastycznym systemie CMS WordPress.
Oddajemy w Twoje ręce serwisy, które zachwycają dopracowanym designem, gwarantują pełne bezpieczeństwo i błyskawicznie wczytują się na absolutnie każdym urządzeniu.
Z powodzeniem wspieramy rozwój biznesu z całego Leszna oraz południowo-zachodniej Wielkopolski.

Liderowanie w wyszukiwarce (Lokalne SEO)
Od pierwszej linijki kodu optymalizujemy Twoją stronę pod kątem algorytmów Google. Budujemy mocną architekturę i treść, by firma z Leszna szybko zdobywała pozycje na zapytania klientów z całego regionu i sąsiednich powiatów.
Technologia z myślą o smartfonach (RWD)
Twoi klienci szukają usług w drodze i na telefonach. Tworzymy serwisy w pełni responsywne, które płynnie dopasowują się do każdego ekranu, zapewniając bezbłędne doświadczenia mobilne i premiowanie przez wyszukiwarki.
Architektura nastawiona na sprzedaż (UX)
Estetyka idzie u nas w parze z użytecznością. Projektujemy logiczne ścieżki i mocne wezwania do akcji (CTA), które skutecznie prowadzą odwiedzającego do kontaktu z Twoim działem handlowym w Lesznie.
Pełna samodzielność dzięki WordPress
Dajemy Ci narzędzie, z którym poradzisz sobie sam. Oparty na systemie WordPress intuicyjny panel pozwoli Ci dodawać aktualności, realizacje czy nowe pakiety usług w zaledwie kilka chwil – bez znajomości programowania.
Błyskawiczne ładowanie i wydajność
Szybkość to więcej zadowolonych klientów. Stosujemy zaawansowane metody optymalizacji kodu, cachowania oraz kompresji mediów, dzięki czemu Twoja witryna otwiera się w mgnieniu oka, zatrzymując użytkowników na dłużej.
Zbuduj silną pozycję na pograniczu Wielkopolski i Dolnego Śląska. Skontaktuj się z nami, a stworzymy dla Ciebie profesjonalną stronę internetową, która skutecznie rozwinie Twój biznes w Lesznie i okolicach.

Analiza i Strategia
Rozmowę o Twoim biznesie zaczynamy od zbadania lokalnej konkurencji w Wielkopolsce, ustalamy docelowych klientów i dobieramy najlepsze słowa kluczowe.

Tworzenie stron internetowych Leszno opieramy na nowoczesnych standardach wizualnych. Kładziemy nacisk na estetykę i sprzedaż, by Twoja marka od razu budowała pełne zaufanie.

Kodujemy witrynę oraz sklepy e-commerce na WordPressie, optymalizujemy pod wyszukiwarkę i podłączamy analitykę, oddając w Twoje ręce stabilne narzędzie zarobkowe.
